name: Sealing Of The Holy Spirit
overview: The sealing of the Holy Spirit is a divine mark of ownership and protection given exclusively to believers, signifying their secure relationship with God through Christ. Scripture reveals that Christ Himself was sealed by the Father, affirming His unique authority (John 6:27), and believers are sealed with the Holy Spirit upon faith, serving as a guarantee of their inheritance until the day of redemption (Ephesians 1:13; 4:30; 2 Corinthians 1:22). This seal distinguishes the saints from the wicked, whose judgment remains until all God's servants are sealed (Revelation 7:3), and the concept is typified by Old Testament signs such as circumcision representing righteousness imputed by faith (Romans 4:11).
